scope: BSTO00/03/04 risk prototype. Actual solo Lagger and q1 Constant; every emitted actual Press/Advance immediately replayed on ordinary solo. Complete public player fields/queues/sets and world time/phase/camera compared. No UI/browser/performance acceptance claim, no old per-run goal bands, no seed filtering. Test-only Probe.Master establishes the independent compatible reference.
advanceCostScope: Managed controller Advance includes normal world and planning; excludes test observer replay/audits. Not an isolated planner or native WebGL benchmark.
